itinerary.name: Arrive in San Francisco
itinerary.description: Arrival at San Francisco International Airport and check-in at the accommodation.

itinerary.name: Golden Gate Bridge Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, walk across it, and enjoy stunning views.

itinerary.name: Explore Fisherman's Wharf & Local Cuisine
itinerary.description: Visit Fisherman's Wharf for local seafood delicacies and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere.

itinerary.name: Golden Gate Park
itinerary.description: Explore Golden Gate Park and its beautiful gardens.

itinerary.name: Travel to Yosemite National Park
itinerary.description: Rent a car and drive to Yosemite National Park.

itinerary.name: Hiking in Yosemite National Park
itinerary.description: Spend the day hiking and exploring Yosemite's stunning landscapes.

itinerary.name: Drive to Santa Monica
itinerary.description: Travel from Yosemite National Park to Santa Monica.

itinerary.name: Beach Day in Santa Monica
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxing beach day at Santa Monica Beach.

itinerary.name: Exploring Hollywood
itinerary.description: Discover Hollywood, including the Walk of Fame and various attractions.

itinerary.name: Travel back to San Francisco
itinerary.description: Drive back to San Francisco from Los Angeles.

itinerary.name: Final Shopping and Departure Preparation
itinerary.description: Last-minute shopping in San Francisco, including malls and artisanal shops.

itinerary.name: Departure from San Francisco
itinerary.description: Check-out from the hotel and depart for the airport.

accommodations.name: Hotel Nikko San Francisco
accommodations.description: Modern hotel located in the heart of San Francisco with easy access to attractions.

accommodations.name: Airbnb Beachfront House
accommodations.description: Cozy beachfront property ideal for relaxation with views of the ocean.

transportation.details: Take BART from SFO to Powell St Station, then transfer to Muni bus/trolley to the hotel.
Take Muni bus #28 to Golden Gate Bridge. Total travel time: approximately 30 minutes.
Take Muni bus #28 back to the Embarcadero, then switch to the F-line streetcar to Fisherman's Wharf.
Economy rental car for the full duration of the trip, to be returned in San Francisco.
Continue driving from Yosemite to Santa Monica. Estimated fuel cost: $40.
Uber ride to Hollywood, approximately 30 minutes.
Return car upon arrival in San Francisco.
